title: A study of holes: Topological analysis reveals crowd dynamics regimes in a bidirectional corridor scenario
summary: This study harnesses topological analysis in an attempt to reveal structure in the dynamics of a crowd. Topology and in particular persistent homology characterizes relational structures in data through the number of connected components and holes, that is, a loop of pairwise connection with no connections across it. We apply this universal data analysis method to a simulated time series of individual pedestrian positions of a crowd moving through a wide corridor -- either uni- or bidirectional.
